summary: Willis Lease Finance Corp filed an 8-K reporting that its Board and stockholders approved a certificate-of-incorporation amendment effecting a 3-for-1 forward stock split, with a record date of July 6, 2026. The amendment is expected to become effective after market close on or about July 17, 2026, and split-adjusted trading to begin on or about July 21, 2026. No deal terms (price, premium, consideration) apply as this is a capital-structure change. No other special-situation mechanics are present. The filing is a routine forward split disclosure, not a special situation; thus the appropriate category is Other.
